sn22.85:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā sārīputto sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassārāme.
sn22.85:1.2: tena kho pana samayena yamakassa nāma bhikkhuno evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ hoti
sn22.85:1.3: tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā khīṇāsavo bhikkhu kāyassa bhedā ucchijjati vinassati na hoti parammaraṇāti.
sn22.85:2.1: assosuṃ kho sambahulā bhikkhū yamakassa kira nāma bhikkhuno evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ hoti
sn22.85:2.2: tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā khīṇāsavo bhikkhu kāyassa bhedā ucchijjati vinassati na hoti parammaraṇāti.
sn22.85:2.3: atha kho te bhikkhū yenāyasmā yamako tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā yamakena saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu
sn22.85:2.4: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ yamakaṃ etadavocuṃ
sn22.85:3.1: saccaṃ kira te āvuso yamaka evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ
sn22.85:3.2: tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā khīṇāsavo bhikkhu kāyassa bhedā ucchijjati vinassati na hoti parammaraṇāti.
sn22.85:3.3: evaṃ khvāhaṃ āvuso bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā
sn22.85:3.4: khīṇāsavo bhikkhu kāyassa bhedā ucchijjati vinassati na hoti parammaraṇāti.
sn22.85:4.1: mā āvuso yamaka evaṃ avaca mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya
sn22.85:4.2: khīṇāsavo bhikkhu kāyassa bhedā ucchijjati vinassati na hoti parammaraṇāti.
sn22.85:4.3: evaṃpi kho āyasmā yamako tehi bhikkhūhi vuccamāno tatheva taṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ thāmasā parāmāsā abhinivissaṃ voharati
sn22.85:4.4: tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā khīṇāsavo bhikkhu kāyassa bhedā ucchijjati vinassati na hoti parammaraṇāti.
sn22.85:5.1: yato kho te bhikkhū nāsakkhiṃsu āyasmantaṃ yamakaṃ etasmā pāpakā diṭṭhigatā vivecetuṃ. atha kho te bhikkhū uṭṭhāyāsanā yenāyasmā sārīputto tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ sārīputtaṃ etadavocuṃ
sn22.85:5.2: yamakassa nāma āvuso sārīputta bhikkhuno evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ
sn22.85:5.3: tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā khīṇāsavo bhikkhu kāyassa bhedā ucchijjati vinassati na hoti parammaraṇāti
sn22.85:5.4: sādhāyasmā sārīputto yena yamako bhikkhu tenupasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyāti.
sn22.85:5.6: atha kho āyasmā sārīputto sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallāṇā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā yamako tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā yamakena saddhiṃ sammodi …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sārīputto āyasmantaṃ yamakaṃ etadavoca
sn22.85:6.1: saccaṃ kira te āvuso yamakaṃ evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ
sn22.85:6.2: tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā khīṇāsavo bhikkhu kāyassa bhedā ucchijjati vinassati na hoti parammaraṇāti.
sn22.85:6.3: evaṃ khvāhaṃ āvuso bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā khīṇāsavo bhikkhu kāyassa bhedā ucchijjati vinassati na hoti parammaraṇāti.
sn22.85:10.2: rūpaṃ. vedanā. saññā. saṅkhārā. viññāṇaṃ tathāgatoti samanupassasīti.
sn22.85:11.2: ayaṃ so arūpī avedano asaññī asaṅkhāro aviññāṇo tathāgatoti samanupassasīti.
sn22.85:11.4: ettha ca te āvuso yamaka diṭṭheva dhamme saccato tathato tathāgato anupalabbhiyamāno kallaṃ nu te taṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ
sn22.85:11.5: tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā khīṇāsavo bhikkhu kāyassa bhedā ucchijjati vinassati na hoti parammaraṇāti.
sn22.85:12.1: ahu kho me taṃ āvuso sārīputta pubbe aviddasuno pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ
sn22.85:12.2: idañca pana me āyasmato sārīputtassa dhammadesanaṃ sutvā tañceva pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ pahīnaṃ dhammo ca me abhisamitoti.
sn22.85:13.1: sace taṃ āvuso yamaka evaṃ puccheyyuṃ
sn22.85:13.2: yo so āvuso yamaka bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā kiṃ hotīti
sn22.85:13.3: evaṃ puṭṭho tvaṃ āvuso yamaka kinti byākareyyāsīti.
sn22.85:13.5: yo so āvuso yamaka bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā kiṃ hotīti
sn22.85:13.9: yaṃ dukkhaṃ taṃ niruddhaṃ tadatthaṃ gataṃ.
sn22.85:13.15: yaṃ dukkhaṃ taṃ niruddhaṃ tadatthaṃ gatanti
sn22.85:13.16: evaṃ puṭṭho ahaṃ āvuso evaṃ byākareyyanti.
sn22.85:14.2: tenahāvuso yamaka upamante karissāmi etasseva atthassa bhiyyosomattāya ñāṇāya.
sn22.85:14.3: seyyathāpi āvuso yamaka gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā aḍḍho mahaddhano mahābhogo
sn22.85:14.5: tassa koci deva puriso uppajjeyya anatthakāmo ahitakāmo ayogakkhemakāmo jīvitā voropetukāmo
sn22.85:14.7: ayaṃ kho gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā aḍḍho mahaddhano mahābhogo
sn22.85:14.9: na hāyaṃ sukaro pasayha jīvitā voropetuṃ
sn22.85:14.11: so taṃ gahapatiṃ vā gahapatiputtaṃ vā upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadeyya
sn22.85:14.13: tamenaṃ so gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā upaṭṭhāpeyya
sn22.85:14.14: so upaṭṭhaheyya pubbuṭṭhāyī pacchānipātī kiṃkārapaṭisāvī manāpacārī piyavādī
sn22.85:14.15: tassa so gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā mittatopi naṃ daheyya
sn22.85:14.18: yadā kho āvuso tassa purisassa evamassa
sn22.85:14.19: saṃvissaṭṭho kho myāyaṃ gahapati vā gahapatiputto vāti atha naṃ rahogataṃ viditvā tiṇhena satthena jīvitā voropeyya.
sn22.85:15.2: yadāpi so puriso amuṃ gahapatiṃ vā gahapatiputtaṃ vā upasaṅkamitvā evamāha
sn22.85:15.3: upaṭṭhaheyyaṃ taṃ bhanteti tadāpi so vadhakova
sn22.85:15.6: yadāpi so upaṭṭhāti pubbuṭṭhāyī pacchānipātī kiṃkārapaṭisāvī manāpacārī piyavādī tadāpi so vadhakova
sn22.85:15.9: yadāpi naṃ rahogataṃ viditvā tiṇhena satthena jīvitā voropeti tadāpi so vadhakova
sn22.85:15.13: evameva kho āvuso assutavā puthujjano ariyānaṃ adassāvī ariyadhammassa akovido ariyadhamme avinīto sappurisānaṃ adassāvī sappurisadhammassa akovido sappurisadhamme avinīto
sn22.85:15.14: rūpaṃ attato samanupassati rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ attani vā rūpaṃ rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ.
sn22.85:15.18: viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassati …pe… viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ.
sn22.85:16.1: so aniccaṃ rūpaṃ aniccaṃ rūpanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti
sn22.85:16.2: aniccaṃ vedanaṃ aniccā vedanāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti
sn22.85:16.3: aniccaṃ saññaṃ aniccā saññāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti
sn22.85:16.4: anicce saṅkhāre aniccā saṅkhārāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti
sn22.85:16.5: aniccaṃ viññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
sn22.85:17.1: dukkhaṃ rūpaṃ dukkhaṃ rūpanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti
sn22.85:17.5: dukkhaṃ viññāṇaṃ dukkhaṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
sn22.85:18.1: anattaṃ rūpaṃ anattaṃ rūpanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti
sn22.85:18.5: anattaṃ viññāṇaṃ anattaṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
sn22.85:19.1: saṅkhataṃ rūpaṃ saṅkhataṃ rūpanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti
sn22.85:19.5: saṅkhataṃ viññāṇaṃ saṅkhataṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
sn22.85:20.1: vadhakaṃ rūpaṃ vadhakaṃ rūpanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti
sn22.85:20.5: vadhakaṃ viññāṇaṃ vadhakaṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
sn22.85:21.1: so rūpaṃ upeti upādiyati adhiṭṭhāti attā meti
sn22.85:21.5: viññāṇaṃ upeti upādiyati adhiṭṭhāti attā meti.
sn22.85:21.6: tassime pañcupādānakkhandhā upetā upādinnā dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya saṃvattanti.
sn22.85:22.1: sutavā ca kho āvuso ariyasāvako ariyānaṃ dassāvī ariyadhammassa kovido ariyadhamme suvinīto …pe… sappurisadhamme suvinīto
sn22.85:22.2: na rūpaṃ attato samanupassati na rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ na attani vā rūpaṃ na rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ
sn22.85:22.6: na viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassati na viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānaṃ
sn22.85:22.7: na attani vā viññāṇaṃ na viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ.
sn22.85:23.1: so aniccaṃ rūpaṃ aniccaṃ rūpanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
sn22.85:23.5: aniccaṃ viññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn22.85:24.1: dukkhaṃ rūpaṃ dukkhaṃ rūpanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
sn22.85:24.5: dukkhaṃ vaññāṇaṃ dukkhaṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn22.85:25.1: anattaṃ rūpaṃ anattaṃ rūpanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
sn22.85:25.5: anattaṃ viññāṇaṃ anattaṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn22.85:26.1: saṅkhataṃ rūpaṃ saṅkhataṃ rūpanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
sn22.85:26.5: saṅkhataṃ viññāṇaṃ saṅkhataṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn22.85:27.1: vadhakaṃ rūpaṃ vadhakaṃ rūpanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
sn22.85:27.4: vadhake saṅkhāre vadhakā saṅkhārāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
sn22.85:27.5: vadhakaṃ viññāṇaṃ vadhakaṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn22.85:28.1: so rūpaṃ na upeti na upādiyati na adhiṭṭhāti attā meti
sn22.85:28.5: viññāṇaṃ na upeti na upādiyati na adhiṭṭhāti attā meti.
sn22.85:28.6: tassime pañcupādānakkhandhā anupetā anupādinnā dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya saṃvattantīti.
sn22.85:28.7: evañhetaṃ āvuso sārīputta hoti yesaṃ āyasmantānaṃ tādisā sabrahmacārino anukampakā atthakāmā ovādakā anusāsakā
sn22.85:28.8: idañca pana me āyasmato sārīputtassa dhammadesanaṃ sutvā anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuttanti.
